name: 86327 · Dewey, AZ
findings: ZIP 86327 (Dewey) has 20 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 86327 (Dewey) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
